synopsis: A heroic and mighty adventurer dreams of...opening a pharmacy? Red was once a member of the Hero's party, a powerful group destined to save the world from the evil forces of Taraxon, the Raging Demon Lord. That is, until one of his comrades kicked him out. Hoping to live the easy life on the frontier, Red's new goal is to open an apothecary. However, keeping the secret of his former life may not be as simple as he thinks. Especially when the beautiful Rit, an adventurer from his past, shows up and asks to move in with him! (Source: Yen Press)

title: Oosaki-san to Komori-san
titleRomaji: Oosaki-san to Komori-san
titleNative: 大崎さんと小森さん
synopsis: A pure love story between two people with a 50cm height difference and mismatched appearances and personalities. The new part-timer is... a child!?!? Osaki-san is tall and has a poker face, making her seem intimidating at first glance, but she's actually shy and kind. The new employee who comes to Osaki-san's workplace is Komori-san, who is only 147cm tall and very friendly. These two, who are complete opposites in appearance and personality, find themselves drawn to each other...!? Osaki-san is clumsy and a crybaby, yet a go-getter, and Komori-san is oblivious, laid-back, and a gentle, introverted type. What will become of the love between these two, who are complete opposites and have a 50cm height difference...? This is the first installment of a hilarious and heartwarming survival-of-the-fittest (?) romantic comedy about these two quirky girls. (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Originally self-published on the author's Twitter, it was later acquired by Kadokawa who released the first volume on May 11, 2026.

title: In Another World With My Smartphone
titleRomaji: Isekai wa Smartphone to Tomo ni.
titleEnglish: In Another World With My Smartphone
titleNative: 異世界はスマートフォンとともに。
synopsis: After a freak accident involving some lightning winds up zapping him dead, 15-year-old Mochizuki Touya wakes up to find himself face-to-face with God. “I am afraid to say that I have made a bit of a blunder...” laments the old coot. But all is not lost! God says that he can reincarnate Touya into a world of fantasy, and as a bonus, he gets to bring his smartphone along with! So begins Touya's adventure in a new, anachronistic pseudo-medieval world. Friends! Laughs! Tears! Inexplicable Deus ex Machina! He sets off on a journey full of wonder as he absentmindedly travels from place to place, following whatever goal catches his fancy. The curtains lift on an epic tale of swords, sorcery, and smartphone apps! (Source: J-Novel Club)

synopsis: In a world of swords and magic, where the Goddess is revered, Lyell Walt was fortunate enough to be born the first son and heir to an earldom. That is, until his parents disown him for losing pitifully in a fight with his younger sister, Ceres. Lyell had once been hailed as a prodigy—a wonder child—but the birth of his sister changed everything. After Ceres wounds him in their duel, an enigmatic old man swoops in to rescue Lyell and bestows upon him a necklace containing a jewel that has been blessed by the goddesses and passed down through the last seven generations of Walt leaders. As Lyell sets out, necklace in hand, will he be able to prove himself despite his humiliating loss to his sister? And moreover, will he be able to solve the mystery behind Ceres’s monstrous strength and the strange sway she seems to hold over his entire family? (Source: J-Novel Club)

titleEnglish: The Voiceless Sacrifice of the Black Dragon
titleNative: 声なき贄姫と黒龍の結婚
synonyms: The Silent Sacrifice Princess And The Black Dragon's Marriage
The Voiceless Sacrifice of the Black Dragon
synopsis: The Kozuki family was granted the Black Dragon's blessing, allowing them to heal the sick and purify impurity with their voices alone. But Ayame's life shatters after her parents' death, leaving her at the mercy of her cruel aunt and uncle, who tortured her until she lost her voice. As their daughter, Mari, rises to become the new priestess, Ayame is offered as a sacrifice to the Black Dragon. "Why do I have to die like this? Please help me!" In response to her desperate plea, the Black Dragon appears as a striking man and takes her hand, whisking her away to his realm. Chosen to be the bride of the Black Dragon Saku, Ayame finds herself in the enchanting Black Dragon Manor, suspended between the heavens and the human world. But jealousy ignites in Mari, who vows to reclaim Saku and make Ayame suffer once more. (Source: Pocket Comics)

title: The Dangers in My Heart: The Romantic Comedy Won’t Start
titleRomaji: Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu: Love Comedy ga Hajimaranai
titleEnglish: The Dangers in My Heart: The Romantic Comedy Won’t Start
titleNative: 僕の心のヤバイやつ ラブコメディが ︀︀始まらない
synopsis: This time around, we follow Kana Ichikawa, Kyotaro’s big sis! She’s got a ton of gal pals, but she’s never had a guy friend before, let alone a boyfriend. She’s given up on ever being popular with the guys, and is just trying to focus on living her best life. But it seems maybe there’s someone harboring secret feelings for her after all. Maybe now she’ll finally get to experience the young love she never got as a teenager? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

titleEnglish: You Can’t Be In a Rom-Com with Your Childhood Friends!

synonyms: No more love with the girls
Osananajimi to wa Love Comedy ni Naranai
소꿉친구와는 러브 코미디를 할 수 없어
synopsis: Eeyuu, a high school boy, has a problem! Two childhood friends "Shio" and "Akari" who go to the same high school are too cute! If they find out that I'm the only one looking sexually at them now that they've grown up, even though I have no intention of doing so... that would be too much! On the other hand, the two childhood friends also have their own secrets...? It's so awkward! It's complicated! But childhood friends are the best! A sweet and impatient love triangle love comedy where you can't be honest! (Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Osaka Hwansangseon
titleRomaji: Osaka Hwansangseon
titleNative: 오사카 환상선
synopsis: Kim Yong, a Zainichi Korean boy from Osaka, accidentally gets caught up in a fight with the nephew of a yakuza. Kim Yong is given the mission of infiltrating a Korean village and stealing an ID card by order of the yakuza. The villagers, who seemed ordinary, seem to be up to something... At first, he only thought of completing the mission and receiving money, but Kim Yong gradually becomes one with the villagers and joins the village's goal of 'establishing a homeland in Osaka. (Source: Naver, translated)
